tasks.title: Released api and probe images pass scoped-token, audit and restart e2e with secret-safe failures
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, Behavior (Required behavior items 1-8 and implementation notes), Checks and Acceptance evidence 1-8; Release prerequisites, Risks, Counterexamples, Performance impact, Security impact and Rollout order. One task keeps the changes to the single e2e script, its failure redaction, both qualifying image pins and the README together for integrated acceptance. scripts/bump-images.sh is included because the section's Files parenthetical names it as the pin-writing tool; run it unchanged, with no edit to the helper. Check release prerequisites first; request a needs-input hold naming any missing qualifying release. Also hold on changed probe reason texts, rejected fixtures or changed CLI admin status codes as the spec requires; do not weaken comparisons, skip checks or silently reshape fixtures.

acceptance.command: gh api repos/lorenzh/pulse-api/git/refs/tags/v<api-version> --jq .object.sha; gh api repos/lorenzh/pulse-api/compare/e1153f99ba3466f6509d29760896e2cdf5061fb5...v<api-version> --jq .status; gh api repos/lorenzh/pulse-probe/git/refs/tags/v<probe-version> --jq .object.sha; gh api repos/lorenzh/pulse-probe/compare/a5dc88d5473a9c63cfd984988201da32cd15ec5c...v<probe-version> --jq .status
acceptance.expected: All requests exit 0; each compare status is ahead or identical. Chosen releases contain the api #617 and probe #552 marker commits respectively. Record both tags and returned SHAs in the PR. If either qualifying published release is missing, request a needs-input hold naming it; no skipped or version-switched checks against old images. Release creation remains a person's prerequisite.

acceptance.command: scripts/bump-images.sh api=<api-version> probe=<probe-version> && scripts/bump-images.sh --verify && git diff main -- common/services.yaml
acceptance.expected: Exit 0; --verify prints ok: for all five pulse services, comparing pins to independent ghcr.io digests. The diff changes exactly the api and probe image lines. Status, notify and console remain at 0.1.0; no other image pin changes. Record the api and probe digests and verify output in the PR.

acceptance.expected: Exit 0 from the repository root.

acceptance.command: bash e2e/metric-is.test.sh && bash e2e/manual-count.test.sh && bash e2e/published-port.test.sh && bash e2e/outage-history.test.sh && scripts/check-setup.sh && bash scripts/check-setup.test.sh && bash scripts/secrets-init.test.sh && bash scripts/bump-images.test.sh && bash scripts/wait-ready.test.sh && bash scripts/init-secrets.test.sh
acceptance.expected: Exit 0 for every helper test and static setup check of the lint job.

acceptance.command: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run check && bun run build
acceptance.expected: Exit 0 using Bun 1.4.0. package.json defines check as lint, typecheck and the full bun test --coverage cli suite; bunfig.toml requires line coverage of at least 0.8, with functions threshold 0. Include the full coverage summary in PR evidence. The CLI tests read embedded common/services.yaml and validate the pin shape, never pin values. Build succeeds locally; the reusable CI check job runs install, lint, typecheck and test only, since its build input defaults to false and deploy passes no override. Do not claim that this job runs build or dist checks.

acceptance.command: bash cli/test/stack.sh full
acceptance.expected: Exit 0 after bun run build; the CLI starts and exercises a live full stack using the new embedded pins. Preserve cli/test/stack.sh unchanged, including its literal GET /admin/config expectations (200 with the admin token, 401 without a token, 403 with a probe token) used by its admin checks. If one changes, request a needs-input hold rather than edit stack.sh. This command tears its stack down before the next live-stack run.

acceptance.command: In separate baseline-main and implementation checkouts, run scripts/init-secrets.sh && docker compose -f full/compose.yaml pull && scripts/measure.sh full; tear each stack down with docker compose -f full/compose.yaml down -v before starting the next run or the e2e
acceptance.expected: Both measurements exit 0 and report start time in seconds and RSS in MiB. Quote the before/after output in the PR for information only; no new performance budget. Teardown frees the ports before compose e2e.

acceptance.command: bash e2e/compose-e2e.sh
acceptance.expected: Exit 0 on the qualifying images. Manual incidents prints exactly 'ok: a write without a token answers 401, a probe token write answers 403'; missing credentials get exactly 401 and a probe credential exactly 403. The failure text for the latter is 'a probe token write was not refused with 403'. '==> Tokens and audit' runs after the read-only-mount check and before persistence, with an ok: line for each of Required behavior 2.1-2.6. Scope check: create e2e-read-checks with [read,checks] gets 201, secret is a string and token.id matches ^tok_[0-9a-f]{24}$; its valid POST for unused e2e-scope-denied with Content-Type application/json and current If-Match gets exactly 403, with no such check in GET /checks, unchanged config ETag and unchanged check/create/ok counter line. Rotation check: creating the isolated probe token at location e2e-rotated gets 201; A gets 200 on /probe/checks; rotate with {} gets 200, a different secret B and numeric previousValidUntil; A and B each get 200 during overlap, B gets exactly 403 on /admin/audit, revoke gets 200, then A and B each get exactly 401 on /probe/checks. Neither stack bootstrap token is rotated or revoked.

acceptance.command: Inspect the audit, export, secrecy and throttle assertions and the output of the same successful bash e2e/compose-e2e.sh run (Required behavior 2.3-2.6 and 3)
acceptance.expected: Audit query /admin/audit?action=check.create&targetId=e2e-api gets 200 and holds a check.create entry with target.kind check, target.id e2e-api and actor.name e2e; retain its id. Query targetKind=token&targetId=<rotated token id> holds token.create, token.rotate and token.revoke, each attributed to e2e. Export gets 200, is nonempty, each line independently passes jq -e 'type == "object"', and includes the retained check.create id. Fixed-string checks find none of the four secrets (e2e admin, read/checks, A, B) in either query body, export or pre-restart compose logs; fail messages name place and role only. No pulse_api_admin_auth_throttled_total series is above 0; only the four specified failed admin authentications are sent. After down/up, the same e2e admin token gets 200 on /admin/config, the retained audit id is returned by the check.create query, and after every service is healthy new-container logs contain none of the four secrets. Secrets stay in shell variables; token-bearing responses are parsed with jq -e without printing secrets or whole responses. Existing assert_absent needles and all other assertions, loopback publishing, restore/teardown order and clean stop stay intact; its failure text and the cleanup log dump change as Required behavior 4 specifies. Output includes the new persistence successes and ends with '==> All checks passed'.

acceptance.command: Review e2e/compose-e2e.sh cleanup, top-level secret initialization, assert_absent and the new secret checks against Required behavior 4
acceptance.expected: On failure cleanup retains the original exit code, prints the Failure heading and compose ps --all, reads compose logs --no-color once and replaces every literal occurrence of all five credentials before printing the dump. Exact role markers are <redacted:e2e-admin-token>, <redacted:e2e-svc-token>, <redacted:read-checks-secret>, <redacted:rotated-secret-a> and <redacted:rotated-secret-b>. Replacements use quoted bash patterns, never secret-as-regex sed or grep; empty or unset values are skipped, new secret variables are initialized empty near the top, and early failure under set -u still reaches teardown. Body sentinel and header env name remain visible markers. assert_absent keeps its needle list and loop but reports only the e2e svc token, body sentinel or header env name role. No fail text prints a credential. Restore, down -v --remove-orphans, e2e/rw removal and secrets cleanup retain their order.

acceptance.command: In an uncommitted scratch copy with the new image pins, restore the issue's historical 401-only probe-write assertion and its failure text, then run bash e2e/compose-e2e.sh; discard the scratch change
acceptance.expected: Exit 1 in Manual incidents with 'FAIL: a probe token write was not refused'. Quote the output in the PR and explain that deploy main accepted both 401 and 403, so unchanged main cannot demonstrate this historical red.

acceptance.command: In an uncommitted scratch copy, restore only the api image line from git show main:common/services.yaml (api 0.1.0), keep the new script and probe pin, then run bash e2e/compose-e2e.sh; discard the scratch pin change
acceptance.expected: Exit 1 in Manual incidents with 'FAIL: a probe token write was not refused with 403'; api 0.1.0 answers 401. Quote the output in the PR. The committed pin remains the qualifying new api release.

acceptance.command: In an uncommitted scratch copy with the new pins, delete only PULSE_PROBE_HEADER_HOSTS from e2e/compose.e2e.yaml, prepare e2e/rw/checks.json as the script's Setup does, run scripts/init-secrets.sh --dir e2e/.secrets, then COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=pulse-e2e COMPOSE_FILE=full/compose.yaml:e2e/compose.e2e.yaml PULSE_SECRETS_DIR=$PWD/e2e/.secrets docker compose up -d; poll GET /checks on the published loopback api port for at most 90 seconds; tear down the same project with down -v and discard the scratch change
acceptance.expected: Within 90 seconds e2e-post has state down and lastReason exactly 'header Authorization env PULSE_HEADER_SVC_TOKEN is not bound to host e2e-target', from probe src/client.ts:160. Quote this alongside the green run's 'e2e-post is up' and 'e2e-post is up again'. The committed binding overlay and e2e-post scenario are unchanged; no denial fixture is added.

acceptance.command: In an uncommitted scratch copy, follow Acceptance evidence 6: create a mode-600 mktemp secrets_file under /tmp and append each known credential immediately after creation. In run a, plant rotated secret A in e2e-target PID 1 stdout after rotation (Required behavior 2.2), then capture bash e2e/compose-e2e.sh stdout/stderr in run-a.log. In a fresh run b, plant the read-checks secret immediately after creation (2.1), add fail "planted failure before the scan" on the next line, and capture run-b.log. Record each exit code without shell tracing. Discard all scratch edits after the runs; keep the temporary secrets file private until the evidence checks below finish
acceptance.expected: Both runs exit 1. Run a fails at the container-log secret scan with a FAIL line naming the role of rotated secret A, never its value. Run b prints exactly FAIL: planted failure before the scan. The dump still shows the planted log entry with the corresponding redaction marker. Neither injection nor a new denial scenario is committed; production secrets remain shell variables only.

acceptance.command: For each planted-leak run, execute grep -cFf "$secrets_file" run-<x>.log; grep -c '^==> Teardown$' run-<x>.log; docker compose -p pulse-e2e ps -a -q | wc -l; docker volume ls -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=pulse-e2e | wc -l. Also run grep -c '<redacted:rotated-secret-a>' run-a.log and grep -c '<redacted:read-checks-secret>' run-b.log. Remove the temporary secrets file and private run artifacts after collecting safe evidence
acceptance.expected: For each run the credential-match count is 0 (grep exits 1 for no match), the Teardown heading count is exactly 1, and remaining pulse-e2e container and volume counts are each 0. Each run's corresponding redaction-marker count is at least 1. Quote counts, role-only FAIL lines and redaction-marker lines in the PR; never quote the secrets file, a credential or a whole token response. These outputs prove both scan-detected and pre-scan failure paths redact the leak and still tear down.

acceptance.command: git diff main -- README.md e2e/compose-e2e.sh && git diff --name-only main
acceptance.expected: Changes are limited to e2e/compose-e2e.sh, common/services.yaml and README.md. The README e2e paragraph names token scopes, rotation/revocation, audit query/export and persistence across restart, without image versions. Script changes implement Required behavior 1-4; items 5-8 preserve the existing header-binding fixture and scenario, all other assertions, exact reason comparisons, secret needle list, loopback publishing, restore/teardown order and clean stop, with only the specified api/probe pins and README updates. scripts/bump-images.sh stays unchanged. No workflow, CLI, overlay or other setup files change; scratch acceptance changes are absent.

acceptance.command: gh pr checks <pr> --watch
acceptance.expected: Exit 0; CI jobs check, lint, pins, minimal, full, demo, dev, cli-build, cli-render, cli-stack (demo, full and minimal) and cli-errors are green. check runs install, lint, typecheck and test; its build/dist steps are skipped. cli-build compiles the CLI with the new pins and runs smoke tests; cli-stack uses them in live stacks. Include command outputs and the full job result in the PR evidence.

acceptance.command: gh pr view <pr> --json body --jq .body; gh pr view <pr> --json body --jq .body | grep -cF e2e-admin-token-sentinel
acceptance.expected: Body includes release tags, SHAs, marker-compare results, ghcr.io digests and verification; both status-code red runs; green full e2e; binding deny and allowed evidence; both planted-leak failure runs with zero credential matches, redaction markers, one teardown and zero remaining containers/volumes; before/after full measurements; required check results including full CLI coverage at the 0.8 line gate and CLI full-stack acceptance; and evidence for each applicable Security impact item (secret absence including both log phases and failure dumps, exact auth statuses and dependency pins). It contains no credential or full token response. grep prints 0 (exit 1 for no match).
